🎶 Love the vibe. I’ll format this into a Suno v4.5-ready prompt with your exact feel and structure.

### LYRICS
[suno tags: tropical pop, 80s undertones, 124 bpm, female vocal sultry→soaring belts, subtle Latin percussion, vintage synth leads, modern trap-influenced drums, wide stereo mix, studio-quality mix, radio-ready polish, breathy, vibrato, emotional resonance, key change up in final chorus, sidechain glue, shimmer reverb, warm tape saturation]

[INTRO]
[instrumental] palm-muted guitar + marimba plucks, tide-like riser, vinyl crackle fade-in

[VERSE 1]
[WHISPERED] you walk in slow motion through my mind  
every conversation, i rewind  
try to play it cool but i can’t hide  
this magnetic pull i feel inside

[PRE-CHORUS]
[BUILDING] tell me how you do it, make me lose control  
every single time you take my soul

[CHORUS]
[POWERFUL] it’s like GRAVITY, pulling me down  
can’t escape your love, spinning around  
every time i try to fly away  
GRAVITY brings me back to stay  
you’re my gravity, gravity

[VERSE 2]
friends keep saying “girl, you need to run”  
but they don’t understand what you’ve become  
you’re the reason that i lose my sleep  
you’re the secret that i’ll always keep

[CHORUS]
it’s like GRAVITY, pulling me down  
can’t escape your love, spinning around  
every time i try to fly away  
GRAVITY brings me back to stay  
you’re my gravity, gravity

[BRIDGE]
[STRIPPED DOWN] newton had it right  
what goes up must fall  
but with you in my life  
i don’t mind at all

[FINAL CHORUS]
[FULL POWER • MODULATE UP A KEY] it’s like GRAVITY, pulling me down  
can’t escape your love, spinning around  
GRAVITY, GRAVITY  
you’re my gravity

[OUTRO]
[instrumental] retro synth lead answers vocal ad-libs, delay tails fade with ocean SFX

---

### STYLE OF MUSIC
Tropical pop with 80s undertones at 124 BPM, glossy but warm, syncopated Latin percussion (congas, shakers) tucked under modern trap-influenced drums and round sub, vintage polysynth lead and glassy FM bells, palm-muted guitar and marimba plucks, sultry breathy female vocal that builds to open-throat belts with tasteful vibrato, call-and-response ad-libs, wide stereo image with shimmer reverb and short slapback delay, gentle tape saturation and sidechain breathing, breakdown bridge that’s nearly a cappella, then key change up for the final chorus, studio-quality mix, radio-ready polish.

---

### EXCLUDED STYLES
No heavy distortion guitars, no screamo, no harsh EDM supersaws, no auto-tune artifacts, no lo-fi hiss, no male rap verses, no dubstep wubs, no overly busy percussion fills, no long intros over 8 bars.

---

Wanna hear a song made through this process?  
👉 https://suno.com/@magor

💡 Quick enhancer if you want a touch more drama next pass: swap the bridge kick for heartbeat thumps, then hit a half-bar silence before the key change to make the final chorus explode.
